Add your organisation

Help populate the network map.

We recommend a moderated process: members submit information, then Nature North London checks it before publication. This keeps the map accurate and avoids duplicate or inappropriate entries.

  1. Give us your organisation and project name.
  2. Add an exact address, postcode, coordinates or map link.
  3. Describe your focus, activities and how people can participate.
  4. Add your website and contact details.
  5. NNL reviews the submission and publishes the approved entry.

Need help? Email team@nnl.org.uk.

This draft opens the submission in your email app. A direct form can be connected once the organisation chooses its form service.
